caption: Your AI assistant in YunLeFun
cloudDescription: Conversations, models and groups live in DSH Web.
cloudHint: Uses your existing SSH keys. Only the host alias is saved.
closeHint: Close the window to keep Yun in the tray.
noLogs: Refresh to load recent local logs.
personaHint: Switching starts a new conversation at the next task; active tasks finish first.
personaSaved: Persona selection saved on the server.
noPersonas: Load the current persona or manage cards in DSH Web.
savedPathsHint: File paths only. Credentials are never copied into the app.
errorSettingsInvalid: Invalid client settings. Existing file was retained.
errorRuntime: Node or the el-bot CLI was not found. Check local settings.
errorTimeout: The request timed out. Refresh to check its state.
errorResponse: The service returned an invalid response.
errorTooLarge: The response exceeded its size limit.
errorSshHost: Use an existing SSH alias: letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens only.
errorSsh: Could not connect. Check SSH, host keys and local port 13080.
errorCloudUrl: The server returned an unexpected Web address.
errorCloudUnavailable: Cloud DSH has not provided its Web entry.
errorPersona: Install the @el-bot/dsh plugin on the cloud host first.
errorProgram: App not found. Set its full path in Settings.
errorPlatform: Configure an executable path for this platform.
errorState: Refresh the bot status before this action.
errorBrowser: Could not open the default browser.
cloudUrlHint: Use an HTTPS login address. Sign in on the server; no model key is stored here.
connectionRequired: Configure your cloud connection in Settings.
errorConnectionAddress: Enter an HTTPS address without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
app.name: Yun
connect.title: Connect to your cloud
connect.subtitle: Your conversations, wherever you are.
connect.instructions: Generate a five-minute pairing code on your cloud server with yun-bot-mobile --pair.
connect.security: Model keys stay in the cloud. This device keeps a revocable credential in Keychain.
sessions.empty.detail: Start a conversation or continue one from your cloud.
chat.empty.detail: Messages and context are saved by your cloud DSH.
chat.too_long: Use up to 4,000 characters per message.
chat.model.next_request: The model change applies to the next model request. The current step keeps using the previous model.
chat.model.switch_failed: Could not switch models. The previous model is still selected.
status.description: Your cloud keeps the bot connected. Pull to refresh the current connection state.
settings.disconnect.title: Disconnect from the cloud?
settings.disconnect.detail: The app removes its credential and requests cloud revocation. Conversations remain in the cloud.
settings.security: You can also revoke this device from your cloud server with yun-bot-mobile --devices and --revoke.
error.server: Enter an HTTPS server address without a path or credentials.
error.unauthorized: This device credential has expired or was revoked. Pair again.
error.pairing: The pairing code is invalid, expired, or already used.
error.rate_limit: Too many pairing attempts. Try again in a minute.
error.unavailable: Cannot reach your cloud. Pull to try again.
error.response: Your server returned an unsupported response.
error.rejected: Your cloud could not accept this request. Try again shortly.
error.restore: Unable to restore the saved device connection.
error.storage: Secure storage is unavailable. Check the app signing and try again.
chat.delivery_unknown: Delivery is unconfirmed. Retry with the same request ID.
connect.disconnect_failed: Could not revoke the device. Reconnect or revoke it on the server.
account.title: YunLeFun account
account.hint: Link your account to sync language preferences. Conversations stay on the paired cloud.
account.not_configured: Account sync is not configured on this cloud yet.
error.account_not_configured: Account sync is not configured on this cloud yet.
error.account_unauthorized: Account authorization expired. Sign in again.
error.account_response: The account service returned an invalid response.
account.discovery_hint: Sign in to see online clouds linked to your account. Each connection still gets its own revocable device credential.
account.instances_empty: No online clouds are linked to this account.
account.discovery_not_configured: Account-based discovery is not configured on this cloud yet.
status.bot.title: A little cloud, by your side
status.bot.subtitle: A gentle swipe, and I’ll follow along.
status.bot.hint: Scroll down to play with Cloud
status.bot.scroll.title: Following your rhythm
status.bot.scroll.detail: Scroll up or down to make Cloud sway. Pause, and it gently settles back into place.
status.bot.tap.title: Say a little hello
status.bot.tap.detail: Tap Cloud for a happy squint, or drag around it to show it the world.
status.bot.accessibility: Little Cloud, tap to say hello
tools.title: Phone tools
tools.mode.detail: Conversations run in the cloud. Phone tools run on this device when you ask.
tools.controller.detail: Install and start the iCTRL runner on this phone, then refresh. Keep remote access off. After a restart, prepare its runtime again.
tools.pair.waiting: Approve “Yun · iPhone” in the iCTRL notification on this phone.
tools.smoke.detail: Opens example.com in your default browser, reads its visible page, then returns here. This takes over the screen briefly.
tools.result.detail: Results stay in memory on this screen. Nothing is uploaded to the cloud.
tools.error.unavailable: Cannot reach iCTRL. Start its runner and refresh.
tools.error.incompatible: This controller uses an unsupported protocol.
tools.error.denied: Pairing was refused or timed out.
tools.error.busy: Another pairing request is pending. Wait before trying again.
tools.error.key_rejected: The controller did not accept this key. Check the phone clock or pair again.
tools.error.response: The controller response could not be verified.
tools.error.too_large: The controller response exceeded the size limit.
tools.error.execution: The task did not finish. Check the phone and try again.
